card.name: Mid-name words in titles and lists
card.fires_on: Inside multiword proper names, such as company or book titles, on the word after China or The. Also the space before a digit in a date or dose, and the word 'and' in lists of names.

modes.label: Company or title words
modes.description: Middle word of a multiword organisation or title, often after China.
modes.example: built by the China Water and<< Electric>> Company became immotorable just a year

modes.label: Space before digits
modes.description: Gap token just before a number in a date or dose.

modes.label: And in name lists
modes.description: The word 'and' joining surnames of architects or people.
modes.example: four decades after it’s prototypes by Mies, Le Corbusier<< and>> others.
